pictures.name: upward_slope
pictures.scene: a long bare hillside of pale scree rising steeply out of the bottom of the frame toward a high bright rim of sky, the lower stones lit warm and every higher fold of the slope sinking into shade

pictures.name: open_sky_above_the_rim
pictures.scene: the sheer top edge of a cliff seen from below, its rock warm and grained along the bottom of the frame, and above it nothing at all but an immense clear sky deepening from pale gold to dark blue

pictures.name: waiting_at_the_court_edge
pictures.scene: two servants standing very small and far off at the shaded edge of a wide stone courtyard, waiting, the paving near them lit low and warm, the great open space at the centre empty and dim
pictures.scene_no_people: a wide stone courtyard standing empty, two shallow hollows worn into the paving at its shaded edge where feet have long waited, the stone lit low and warm there, the centre of the court open and dim

pictures.name: water_jar_set_down
pictures.scene: a tall clay water jar set down on a worn step at the edge of a shaded doorway, its rim catching a thin line of warm light at the bottom of the frame, the doorway behind it opening into still darkness

pictures.name: dawn_over_still_water
pictures.scene: a wide flat sheet of still water reaching from the bottom of the frame to a low far shore, one long band of soft gold dawn light lying across the water at its nearest edge, the sky above deep and quiet

pictures.name: cupped_rock
pictures.scene: a shallow basin of bare rock opened upward like a cupped palm, rainwater standing in its lowest hollow and catching the last warm light, the stone rising away above it into cold unbroken shadow

pictures.name: heap_of_thrown_stones
pictures.scene: a rough heap of thrown stones piled against the foot of an old wall, each stone hard edged and lit sharply from one side along the bottom of the frame, the wall above them blank and dark and featureless

lines.text: I lift up my eyes to You,
look to the hand of their master,
as the eyes of a maidservant
look to the hand of her mistress,
so our eyes are on the LORD our God
Have mercy on us, O LORD, have mercy,
for we have endured much contempt.
We have endured much scorn from the arrogant,
